title: Waddles
description: Waddles texture pack for the piglet in the new snapshot plus a ton of other cool stuff
body:
A texture pack that replaces all pigs with Waddles from Gravity Falls plus a ton of other cool stuff. Just look at him. He's so little and adorable! he even has the spots on the sides of him. I tried to make him as accurate as I could. IT ONLY WORKS WITH 1.26 SNAPSHOT 2-4

I got the idea for this because the new baby pigs have beaty little eyes and it reminded me of Waddles
